svg.title: What a redundant third source can move
svg.desc: The five three-source atoms in which every collection contains source 3 sum to r123 minus r12, and the absolute mass of these atoms lies between the conditional information and its upper bound.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: WHAT A REDUNDANT THIRD SOURCE CAN MOVE
(a) Five positions outside the pair downset
Gold: every member contains source 3. Their sum
is r123 − r12. The other 13 sum to r12;
their individual values can redistribute below {12}.
(c) Near redundancy: the Fano bound forces M to 0
T = S1 ⊕ S2: Δ = 0, yet M > 0
T = S3: Δ = A, so M = Hbin(ε)
decoder error ε of S3 from (S1, S2)
400 random count tables (seed 20261002) and exact families, recomputed exactly from the MGW definitions.
